title: Test allowlist exceptions alongside blocked writing siblings
answers: How do I test a read-only impersonation allowlist change?
How do we prevent workflow writes from becoming available while impersonating?
Where are audience-sizing impersonation regressions covered?
body:
Convention: Extend the existing parameterized cases in posthog/test/test_middleware.py:TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware.test_read_only_impersonation_allows_allowlisted_post for permitted POST actions.
Guard: Pair the exception with writing paths in posthog/test/test_middleware.py:TestImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware.test_read_only_impersonation_blocks_mutating_siblings; workflow coverage includes hog_flows/<id>/publish/ and hog_flows/bulk_delete/.
Failure mode: The allowed-action case catches a regex that stops matching audience sizing; the blocked-sibling cases catch a regex widened to permit workflow writes.
applies: POST exceptions in the read-only impersonation allowlist, especially actions sharing a URL prefix with writes.
